SELECT COUNT(*) AS churned_customers
FROM (
  SELECT o.customer_id
  FROM marts.fct_orders AS o
  WHERE o.status = 'completed'
    AND o.order_date >= DATE '2024-01-01'
    AND o.order_date < DATE '2026-01-01'
  GROUP BY o.customer_id
  HAVING COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE o.order_date < DATE '2025-01-01') > 0
     AND COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE o.order_date >= DATE '2025-01-01') = 0
) AS c
output.explanation: Counts customers with at least one completed order dated in 2024 and none dated in 2025. "Completed" is taken to mean status = 'completed', based on order_date.
